title: The Hour That Returned

journalBlocks.text: A familiar chime returned while the scholar was comparing his notes. The sound was the same. The cup beside him was warmer than his earlier mark recorded, and a fold in the page lay the other way. He could not establish whether the hour had repeated or two paths had approached the same event.
For once he preserved the disagreement. He wrote down the warmth, the fold, and the uncertain order. A recurring sign was no longer enough to erase everything that differed around it.
